title: AARYA Voice Lab Preview Feedback Record (VL-D5 §21-§22)
description: A listener's response to one generated preview iteration -- persists identity.preview.PreviewFeedback.to_dict() exactly (VL-V0 contracts, Phase 3), not a second feedback shape. NOT a training label -- nothing in this project converts a feedback record into model training data.

listened.description: Whether the listener actually played the preview before responding. accepted/rejected must never be recorded with listened=false.

attributes.description: Structured hints, e.g. {"category": "NATURALNESS", "rating": "4"}. Free-form but never a speaker or identity field.
